mechanism_narrative: ERBB4+INSR forced proximity via flexible_GS8 linker (~40 Å) enables transphosphorylation where INSR kinase phosphorylates ERBB4 juxtamembrane tyrosines and ERBB4 kinase phosphorylates INSR juxtamembrane tyrosines. This recruits GRB2/SHC1/GAB1/PIK3R1 (from ERBB4 side) and IRS1/FRS2 (from INSR side) as transphosphorylation-dependent adaptors, activating MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT signaling. PLCG1/PLCG2 are sterically excluded because the ~40 Å linker geometry cannot accommodate the large PLCγ PH-SH2-SH2-SH3 module bridging the two ICDs. The biased output upregulates muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11, MYOM2, TAGLN) via SRF/MRTF and downregulates aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32, TXNIP) via FOXO and AKT-mediated suppression, producing a rejuvenating transcriptional phenotype.
